title: Projective Dolbeault comparison and scalar structure-sheaf cohomology

items.title: Projective Dolbeault comparison and scalar structure-sheaf cohomology
items.statement: Assume AC. For 0≤r≤3, any holomorphic vector bundle E on P^r(C) has its analytic sheaf cohomology naturally identified with the cohomology of the global smooth E-valued Dolbeault complex. In particular H^0(P^r,O)=C and H^q(P^r,O)=0 for q>0. The scalar vanishing is proved by a direct Laurent/Čech calculation on the standard affine cover, including its acyclic intersections and convergent cochain contractions. This statement does not assume GAGA, higher-dimensional Kähler Hodge theory, or arbitrary-coherent projective vanishing.
items.strategy: Generalize the written curve Dolbeault resolution pattern directly in all dimensions ≤3 using local polydisc exactness and smooth-module acyclicity. In the standard projective cover identify finite intersections with products of C and C*, prove scalar acyclicity using explicit pseudoconvex exhaustions and scalar Dolbeault solvability (or direct Laurent solution). Expand holomorphic functions on polyannuli, prove parameter holomorphy, normal convergence and uniqueness by iterated Cauchy integrals. Decompose homogeneous degree-zero Laurent modes and give a sign-correct Čech contracting homotopy for positive degree, verifying subseries extend to the claimed charts and converge locally uniformly. Global degree-zero functions are constants. This source-guided Laurent reconstruction is not supplied by the algebraic O(m) theorem and not proved by Serre’s footnote. For the standard projective cover, intersections are C^a times (C*)^b, not polydiscs. Prove their required scalar acyclicity by an explicit annular-product Dolbeault/exhaustion or Laurent argument before using Leray; local coherent acyclicity alone does not imply it.
items.axiom_base: ZF + full AC; record resolutions, countable shrinking/diagonal choices, Baire/Fréchet arguments and supplier-inherited choice uses precisely. No physical premise.

references.locator: §13 Lemma4 and footnote4, printed pp.20–21: Laurent route is mentioned as unpublished Frenkel calculation, not supplied there. Demailly VII10.6–10.7 pp.348–349 were read but use Hodge/duality/Nakano; not the proposed proof route.
